DevOps Engineer

  • Hyderabad / In-Office
  • Full Time
  • Mid Level

We are looking for a skilled and dynamic DevOps Engineer to join our growing team in Hyderabad. As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for automating and streamlining operations, building CI/CD pipelines, deploying and maintaining applications, and ensuring the stability of our infrastructure. You will be working closely with development and IT teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and efficient systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support automated testing, deployment, and monitoring of applications.

  • Manage containerized applications using Docker and orchestrate them with Kubernetes.

  • Work with AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, etc.) to build and manage cloud infrastructure.

  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and other Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools.

  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues across the full application stack.

  • Implement security best practices across the cloud infrastructure.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful integration and deployment of applications.

  • Continuously evaluate and improve the DevOps processes and tools to ensure high quality, efficiency, and scalability.

Required Skills:

  • Docker: Strong experience with containerization and orchestration.

  • Kubernetes: In-depth knowledge of deploying, managing, and scaling applications in a Kubernetes environment.

  • AWS: Hands-on experience with various AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, Lambda, etc.).

  • CI/CD: Experience with Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, or similar tools.

  • Terraform: Experience in provisioning and managing cloud infrastructure using Terraform or other IaC tools.

  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack).

  • Knowledge of scripting languages like Python, Bash, or similar.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex systems.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with other cloud platforms (Azure, GCP) is a plus.

  • Knowledge of configuration management tools like Ansible, Chef, or Puppet.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • 3+ years of experience in a DevOps or similar role.

  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies and software development life cycle.


  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • AWS
  • CI/CD
  • Terraform

Product Designer

  • Bangalore / Remote
  • Full Time
  • Mid Level

We are seeking a talented and passionate Product Designer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional teams to design user-centric digital products that drive innovation and provide exceptional user experiences. Your expertise in UI/UX, prototyping, and design systems will be key in shaping the visual and functional aspects of our product offerings.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design intuitive, user-friendly interfaces for web and mobile applications.

  • Create high-fidelity prototypes and wireframes that effectively communicate design concepts and user flows.

  • Collaborate with product managers, developers, and other designers to iterate and refine designs based on feedback.

  • Build and maintain design systems that ensure consistency across the product suite.

  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and incorporate insights to improve product usability.

  • Stay up to date with the latest design trends, tools, and best practices to continuously improve design quality.

  • Work within an agile environment to deliver well-crafted design solutions within project timelines.

Required Skills:

  • Figma: Proficient in using Figma for designing, prototyping, and collaboration.

  • UI/UX Design: Strong understanding of both user interface design and user experience principles.

  • Experience in creating and maintaining design systems that ensure product consistency.

  • Ability to create interactive prototypes for user testing and validation.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design and designing for multiple devices.

  • Ability to communicate design concepts clearly and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Proficiency with other design tools like Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar tools is a plus.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in designing for SaaS or enterprise-level products.

  • Familiarity with front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) is a bonus.

  • Knowledge of accessibility best practices in design.

  • Experience with design handoff tools like Zeplin, or similar.

  • Strong visual design skills with a keen eye for detail.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Interaction Design, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years of experience in product design, preferably in a tech-driven environment.

  • A strong portfolio showcasing UI/UX design skills, prototypes, and design systems you’ve worked on.

    • UI/UX
    • Prototyping

    Backend Developer

    • Hyderabad / Hybrid
    • Full Time
    • Senior Level

    We are looking for an experienced and motivated Backend Developer to join our engineering team in Hyderabad. As a Senior Backend Developer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and maintaining the backend architecture of our platform. You will work with cutting-edge technologies such as Python, Django, PostgreSQL, and Redis, ensuring that our systems are scalable, secure, and high-performing.

    Key Responsibilities:

    • Design and develop high-performance, reliable, and scalable backend systems using Python and Django.

    • Work with relational databases like PostgreSQL to design efficient data models and queries.

    • Implement caching solutions using Redis to optimize system performance.

    • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate with frontend components.

    • Containerize applications using Docker to ensure portability and scalability.

    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features.

    • Perform code reviews and mentor junior developers to ensure best practices in backend development.

    • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize backend systems to maintain uptime and performance.

    • Keep up with the latest industry trends and technologies, bringing innovation to our architecture.

    Required Skills:

    • Strong proficiency in Python and experience working with the Django framework.

    • Solid understanding of relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL, and experience with complex query optimization.

    • Hands-on experience with Redis for caching and improving performance.

    • Experience with Docker and containerized environments.

    • Deep understanding of RESTful API design and development.

    • Strong experience with designing scalable backend architecture.

    • Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.

    • Proficient in version control using Git.

    • Experience in implementing security best practices in backend systems.

    Preferred Skills:

    • Familiarity with microservices architecture.

    • Experience with asynchronous programming using frameworks like Celery.

    • Exposure to DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform).

    • Knowledge of Agile methodologies and working in fast-paced development cycles.

    • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.

    Qualifications:

    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

    • 5+ years of professional experience in backend development.

    • A portfolio or GitHub showcasing your backend projects and contributions.

        • Django

        Data Scientist

        • Hyderabad / In-Office
        • Full Time
        • Senior Level

        We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join our team in Hyderabad. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in Machine Learning, Python, and data analysis to build and deploy data-driven models that provide actionable insights for key business decisions. You will work with large datasets, analyze complex problems, and develop cutting-edge machine learning algorithms that drive the company's growth and innovation.

        Key Responsibilities:

        • Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform business strategies.

        • Build and deploy machine learning models to solve critical business challenges.

        • Work closely with business stakeholders to translate business problems into data-driven solutions.

        • Utilize Python and libraries such as TensorFlow to develop, train, and fine-tune machine learning models.

        • Write complex SQL queries to extract and manipulate data from relational databases.

        • Present data insights and model results clearly through data visualization techniques (using tools like Matplotlib, Seaborn, or Tableau).

        • Continuously improve model accuracy and efficiency based on business feedback and model performance.

        • Stay up to date with the latest research and advancements in machine learning and data science.

        Required Skills:

        • Strong proficiency in Python and experience with machine learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.

        • Expertise in building and deploying machine learning models across different business problems.

        • Strong knowledge of SQL for data extraction, manipulation, and transformation.

        • Experience with data visualization tools and techniques to communicate complex results.

        • Proficiency in statistical modeling, hypothesis testing, and predictive analytics.

        • Strong analytical skills with the ability to work with large, unstructured data sets and turn them into actionable insights.

        • Experience in using tools like Jupyter Notebooks, SciKit Learn, or Pandas for data analysis and model building.

        Preferred Skills:

        • Experience in working with cloud-based machine learning services (AWS, Azure, GCP).

        • Familiarity with Big Data tools and frameworks like Hadoop, Spark, or similar.

        • Expertise in deep learning techniques and frameworks (e.g., Keras, TensorFlow, etc.).

        • Knowledge of advanced statistical techniques and methods.

        • Experience in deploying machine learning models to production environments.

        Qualifications:

        • Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

        • 5+ years of experience as a Data Scientist or in a similar analytical role.

        • A strong portfolio showcasing your work on real-world machine learning projects and model development.


        • Python
        • Machine Learning
        • TensorFlow
        • SQL
        • Data Visualization
